name: eyfi-leaderboard-monorepo
description: Production-Grade Leaderboard Engine for EYFI 30-Day Challenge

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.test:health: node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3001/api/health', res => { if(res.statusCode === 200) { console.log('✅ Backend API Health check passed'); process.exit(0); } else { process.exit(1); } });"
